decision.unit: candidate environment within a matched panel
actions: retain the starting policy when its outcome is released
decision.seed_handling: aggregate independent training seeds by candidate for selection; retain seed variation as uncertainty
decision.published_aggregate_handling: weight candidate panels equally within each study and report study-macro results
decision.native_outcomes: orient higher-is-better and normalize only within the panel for fitting and scoring
decision.ties: split selection credit equally across exact predicted or observed ties

allowed: starting-policy and domain-native measurements available before training
training context and costs known at the prediction cutoff
prior outcomes permitted by the training fold
excluded: source, candidate, path, hash, or filename identity used as a predictive feature
records outside the frozen training fold
information_boundary.normalization: feature normalization is fit inside the training fold; outcome-blind normalization across target candidates is allowed only when the native study defines it
information_boundary.missing_values: preserve missingness with an observed-value indicator; never replace missing cost or failure with zero

inputs: outcome-blind rule released by the originating study

methods.eligibility: run only when the training fold has at least eight independent groups and every hyperparameter is selected inside grouped inner validation
score after deterministic serialization, retrieval, contamination audit, and inference-cost accounting are frozen

selection.hyperparameters: nested grouped validation inside the training fold
selection.complexity_rule: advance a more complex method only when it improves complete-study holdouts over the strongest simpler baseline

primary: regression-selection rate when a starting-policy reference exists
secondary: native-unit prediction error where units remain comparable

gates.structured_replay: measurement_ridge must improve study-macro regret over the strongest simple baseline without increasing regression selection
gates.multimodal_replay: each added modality must improve a complete-study holdout after acquisition and inference cost
gates.prospective_test: freeze only after the selected replay method passes support, chronology, and abstention audits
gates.bounded_loop: begin only after a scored prospective test
